sentences.text: Mr. Kanva Antani, learned Asst. Government Pleader and Mr. Chirayu Mehta, learned counsel for Mr. Devang Vyas, learned Additional Solicitor General, pray for some more time to file the status Report as directed in the previous order dated 10.08.2021.

2. During the course of arguments today, we have been taken to Regulation 4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011, which are quoted below for ready reference:
4.Declaration regarding Veg or Non-Veg- (i) Every package of "Non-Vegetarian" food shall bear a declaration to this effect made by a symbol and colour code as stipulated below to indicate that the produce is Non-Vegetarian Food.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The symbol shall consist of a brown colour filled circle having a diameter not less than the minimum size specified in the Table mentioned in the regulation 2.2.2(4)(iv), inside a square with brown outline having sides double the diameter of the circle as indicated below:
Brown colour C/WPPIL/172/2017 ORDER DATED: 31/08/2021 MUMBAI JIVDAYA MANDALI, [THE BOMBAY HUMANITERIAN LEGUE] Versus STANDARD REVIEW CALL & 2 other(s)
(ii) Where any article of food contains egg only as Non-Vegetarian ingredients, the manufacturer or packer or seller may give declaration to this effect in addition to the said symbol.
(iii) Every package of Vegetarian Food shall bear a declaration to this effect by a symbol and colour code as stipulated below for this purpose to indicate that the product is Vegetarian Food.

The symbol shall consist of a green colour filled circle,
having a diameter not less than the green outline having size double the diameter of the circle, as indicated below:
Green colour (iv) Size of the logo Sl. No. Area of principle display panel minimum size of diameters in mm 2.
Above 100 cms.
Square upto 500 3.

Above 500 cms Square upto 2500 cms C/WPPIL/172/2017 ORDER DATED:
31/08/2021 MUMBAI JIVDAYA MANDALI, [THE BOMBAY HUMANITERIAN LEGUE] Versus STANDARD REVIEW CALL & 2 other(s)
3.

The learned counsel for the Government also drew attention to the definition of the term "Vegetarian Food" as defined in Regulation 1.2.11, definition of "ingredient" as defined in Section 3(y) and "food additive"

2
as defined in Section 3(k) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006

3(y) "ingredient" means any substance, including a food additive used in the manufacture or preparation of food and present in the final product, possibly in a modified form;"
C/WPPIL/172/2017 ORDER DATED: 31/08/2021 MUMBAI JIVDAYA MANDALI, [THE BOMBAY HUMANITERIAN LEGUE] Versus STANDARD REVIEW CALL & 2 other(s)
4.
During the course of discussion, we have found that there is no separate regulation for the Red Dot (Non-Vegetarian Food) and eatables sold in the market.
5. The learned counsel at bar submitted that perhaps there was a red color dot earlier in prevalence which was changed to brown for ingredients in the form of eggs vide Clause 4 (ii) quoted above.

6. The learned Government counsel also submitted before us that he wants to take instructions about the full facilities available to analyze these products, with the approved Laboratories for 'ingredients' as well as 'additives' as defined.
7. We expect comprehensive and detailed Affidavits both from the State as well as the Central Government in this PIL Petition.

The Affidavit already filed by the Central Government by Mr.
Deepak Pandey, Asst. Director of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, FDA, is on record.
